definitions.explanation: Refers to something written or mentioned earlier in a document or text. A formal written expression used in business correspondence, official documents, and academic writing.

examples.japanese: {上記|じょうき}の{内容|ないよう}をご{確認|かくにん}ください。
{上記|じょうき}の{住所|じゅうしょ}にお{送|おく}りください。
examples.english: Please send it to the address mentioned above.

examples.japanese: {上記|じょうき}の{条件|じょうけん}に{同意|どうい}いただける{場合|ばあい}は、{署名|しょめい}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: If you agree to the conditions mentioned above, please sign.

notes:
USAGE: {上記|じょうき} is a formal written expression. It is rarely used in casual speech. In conversation, people typically say {上|うえ}に{書|か}いてある or {先|さき}ほどの instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上記|じょうき}の{通|とお}り (as stated above)
- {上記|じょうき}の{内容|ないよう} (the above contents)
- {上記|じょうき}の{住所|じゅうしょ} (the above address)
- {上記|じょうき}の{条件|じょうけん} (the above conditions)

PAIR: The opposite is {下記|かき} (below-mentioned). These are often used together in documents: {上記|じょうき}...{下記|かき}...
